Medium Affected: WATER

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 29.321389, -92.468889 (Explicit)
Report Description
CALLER IS REPORTING A GROUNDED DRILLING RIG (PLATFORM) THAT IS ACTIVELY SHEENING. THE DRILLING RIG WAS BEING TOWED TO BROWNSVILLE, TX FOR SCRAPPING WHEN IT BEGAN TO LIST AT APPROXIMATELY 0800 LOCAL. THE RIG WAS BROUGHT INTO SHALLOW WATER WITHIN VERMILION BLOCK 65 TO BETTER MANAGE THE SITUATION. THE RIG HAS A 20 DEGREE LIST ON THE STARBOARD SIDE AND IS GROUNDED ON THE PORT SIDE. CALLER REPORTED APPROXIMATELY 1000 GALLONS OF DIESEL IN A BLADDER TANK AND APPROXIMATELY 6 BARRELS OF HYDRAULIC OIL CONTAINED IN THE THREE PLATFORM LEGS (2BBLS PER LEG). IT IS UNKNOWN AT THIS TIME WHERE THE SHEENING IS COMING FROM OR WHICH OIL IT MAY BE.
